Wonderful Stay at Comfort Inn, Delhi
I recently stayed at Comfort Inn during my visit to Delhi for 4days and it was a fantastic experience! The hotel lived up to its name by providing a very comfortable and relaxing stay. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and equipped with all the necessary amenities.
The staff were extremely polite and attentive, always ready to assist with a smile. The location of the hotel was convenient, with easy access to key attractions and transportation.
Overall, Comfort Inn exceeded my expectations in terms of service and hospitality. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Delhi and looking for a hassle-free and pleasant stay.

negative_snippets: I am a solo traveler and had never stayed at this hotel before. From the moment I arrived, the reception was ice-cold and completely unwelcoming. Whenever I asked a simple question, I was met with silence or flat-out ignored. Instead of feeling like a guest, I felt like I was being watched and judged the entire time, as if I were some kind of animal on display. The atmosphere was hostile, uncomfortable, and downright creepy. I left feeling shaken and unwelcome. Easily one of the worst stays I have ever had.
